text_simplified: Parents should reduce the amount of sugar in homemade sweets and choose healthy drinks like water instead of sweetened juices. Make sure to read food labels to know the amounts of fats, sugars, and salt in foods. Ensure there are no allergy-causing ingredients, and store food at a safe temperature between 5 and 60 degrees Celsius.
